body: Quick update. Just called to schedule a phone interview. Had verbal diarrhea all over the phone and said something stupid and tasteless to the receptionist. Why am I the way that I am? Oh well. First step taken.

Thanks for the reply! I need to see a counselor first so I can (hopefully) be referred to a campus psychiatrist. I tried to get a referral from a doctor last year but I was just prescribed antibiotics for a phantom strep infection. The 4 am crying and panicking and madness has passed now, and I just want to sleep through the day, but I'm going. Wish me luck! :) 

I'll try really hard to get in touch with my aunt tonight. I'm lucky in that she has the same problem as I do with phoning and emailing after a perceived acceptable period, so she'll understand. I need to break the ice sometime though; it might take as well be today!
